# Third-party dependencies

| Directory | Purpose | Terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advancedfx` | Camera path/input and format compatibility | MIT; some `AfxMath.cpp` sections are CC0 |
| `cssv34-sdk` | Build-4044 headers and x86 libraries | Upstream notice; non-commercial restriction |
| `imgui` | In-game GUI | MIT |
| `minhook` | x86 Direct3D 9 detours | BSD 2-Clause |

See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Vendored code is kept close to upstream except for small compatibility changes required by ART.
